items: 【Versatile 9-Piece Outdoor Dining Set】 Complete your outdoor space with this durable patio table and chairs set, featuring 1 table and 8 Textilene chairs. The large outdoor dining table offers ample room for dining and entertaining, while the sturdy chairs provide lasting comfort. This 8 seater dining table set is perfect for family meals, gatherings with friends, and enhancing your patio, deck, or backyard.

【Spacious Outdoor Dining Table】 Our centerpiece patio table measures a generous 84”L x 33.9”W, comfortably seating up to 10 people. Engineered with a robust HDPE outdoor furniture tabletop and sturdy frame, it supports up to 430 lbs and features a convenient integrated umbrella hole for added versatility.

【Textilene Dining Chairs】 Each chair in this patio dining set features breathable Textilene mesh fabric designed for cool, comfortable outdoor seating. The quick-drying, UV-resistant material promotes airflow and reduces heat buildup. Paired with a supportive frame, ergonomic contouring, a comfortable backrest, and sturdy armrests, these chairs provide reliable support while accommodating up to 330 lbs per chair.

【All-Weather HDPE Materials】 Crafted from high-density polyethylene, this patio furniture set is built to withstand sun, rain, and temperature fluctuations. The material resists fading, cracking, and moisture, ensuring your outdoor patio table and chairs look new for years

【Low-Maintenance & Easy Clean】 The HDPE patio furniture surfaces resists fading. Simply clean with mild soap and water—no sanding, sealing, or complicated upkeep required for your SERWALL outdoor furniture. HDPE is a 100% recyclable material, making this set a durable and eco-conscious choice for your outdoor space

【After-sales Support】We stand behind the quality of our hdpe outdoor dining set. Our dedicated customer support team is here to assist with any questions about product care, ensuring your long-term satisfaction.

【Elegant Wood-Grain Aesthetics】 Enjoy the warm, natural look of wood without the maintenance. This outdoor dining set features a realistic wood-grain texture and sleek lines that blend seamlessly into any outdoor dining space

【Stainless Steel Hardware】 Every joint is secured with corrosion-resistant stainless steel hardware, guaranteeing your patio table and chairs remain sturdy, stable, and rust-free through seasons of outdoor use.
【Hassle-Free Assembly】 We’ve simplified setup with partially pre-assembled components and clear instructions. All necessary tools and hardware are included for a straightforward assembly experience.

【Family-Safe Design】 Designed with families in mind, this HDPE dining set ensures comfort and safety for all ages. Its smooth, rounded edges eliminate the risks of sharp metal frames, making it the ideal and worry-free choice for homes with children. Enjoy relaxed gatherings where everyone can feel secure.

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Attach legs with screws. Tighten using the provided tool. Insert dowels into pre-drilled holes. Align panels and secure with bolts.
